name: Punggol
tagline: HDB modelled the wind here before building. Can you?
brief: Place all 6 blocks in the highlighted areas. Keep the walkways breezy and house everyone.

calibration.method: provisional after wind-chill cap 2026-10-12: exposed breezy walkway ~31.5 C (comfort 0.4), shaded ~28 C; threshold set between all-exposed and half-shaded; recalibrate with ?calib=1 on a real GPU
